title: Chapter 1527 - 629: Nine
content:
Chapter 1527: Chapter 629: Nine-Fire Refines Cloud Material

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord took a step into the void.

He summoned the Mystic Flame Dragon Claw Ring, transforming into five crimson gold dragon claw phantoms that tore the clear sky, directly grasping that figure.

This claw strike was extremely fast!

Where the claw marks passed, five charred black cracks were left in the air, as if the clear sky was forcibly scratched by dragon claws.

Yun Wuji’s Wind Listening Bell lightly rang.

The exceedingly light bell sound was almost inaudible amid the reverberations of Thunder Fire, but Yun Wuji had already shifted a half inch. The crimson gold dragon claw grazed his shoulder, tearing off a large piece of gray-white garment corner.

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s other palm had already pressed downward with the momentum, silently adhering the Pill Fire Soul Lock to Yun Wuji’s protective cloud light surrounding him.

The crimson gold pill fire did not explode, only rotated and constricted, like tightening fire control during alchemy, coercing Yun Wuji’s surrounding mana back into his body bit by bit.

Yun Wuji frowned slightly.

In the eyes of the Nine Fire Dragon Lord, a fierce light flashed, suddenly closing in midair, the Mystic Flame Dragon Claw Ring glowing again.

"Got you!"

At Yun Wuji’s waist, the Fog Heart Jade Pendant emerged, radiating gentle white light.

Gathering and Dispersing in One Breath.

His figure suddenly scattered, transforming into a patch of white mist, spilling through the gaps of the pill fire vortex and dragon claw.

The mist did not flee far but reformed into a human form a hundred feet away. However, this time, a scorch mark of crimson gold appeared on the gray-white daoist robe on his chest, clearly not unscathed.

In the Nanming Village’s gathering, this round of assaults from the Nine Fire Dragon Lord made everyone’s hearts slightly quiver.

The Red Robe Guest coldly said, "Good, keep pressuring, maintain the strong pressure."

Tan Zhu said indifferently, "Scattering form is not difficult, it’s the reformation that consumes spirit."

Ning Zhuo watched the increasing cloud qi in the clear sky, his expression became more focused. He knew Tan Zhu evaluated extremely accurately, only when the Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s attacks forced Yun Wuji to scatter and reform, could some advantage be gained.

Every retreat of Yun Wuji left a cluster of clouds, with each scattering, mist spread, every burn allowed him to collect back part of the water vapor using the Hidden Cloud Sleeve.

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord fought fiercer, while Yun Wuji continued to nurture the clear sky into his cloud field amidst the fiery battle.

This technique, Ning Zhuo had never seen before, but he had investigated related intelligence: "The[Traceless Cloud Path]of White Cloud Village can be used this way. This is not mentioned in the intelligence."

Observing the Nascent Soul battle broadened his perspective slightly.

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s offensive did not cease.

Fifth Transition, Chaos Spirit.

Heart Fire arrived invisibly!

In Yun Wuji’s always subtle eyes, finally appeared a trace of chaotic ripple. In his ear seemed to resound the roaring furnace fire and the thunderous dragon roars, groups of flames before his eyes transformed into pill furnaces, dragon claws, crimson gold scales, seeking to drag his heart spirit into the Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s battle rhythm.

Yun Wuji lightly exhaled.

Fog Heart Jade Pendant’s white light spun, guarding his mind.

He raised his sleeve and waved, the White Cloud Banner far away suddenly trembled, releasing more cloud qi. The Hidden Cloud Sleeve gathered surrounding mist, kneading it into a cloud curtain, spanning between him and the Nine Fire Dragon Lord.

Inconstant Cloud Curtain!

The cloud curtain was extremely thin, perhaps invisible in Yin Heaven, yet under Jiaoyang it refracted countless fragments of gold. The Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s fire light fell on the cloud curtain, refracted into numerous tiny light patterns. True Fire shone, the figure in the cloud curtain split into three, three into nine, nine divided into dozens of faint shadows.

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s eyes flashed with gravity, simply drawing the Demon Scale Fire Box, directly opening it.

Dark azure demon fire floated from the box, transforming into tiny scaled flames, falling towards the cloud curtain, White Cloud Banner, and cloud qi expelled by the Hidden Cloud Sleeve.

Sixth Transition, Demon Refining.

Demon Fire Erosion!

Numerous scales appeared on the White Cloud Banner surface, the originally pure cloud qi stained with a touch of dark azure. Even the edges of Yun Wuji’s two Hidden Cloud Sleeves showed signs of dark azure scorch marks, as if seared by some cold fire scales.

Demon fire is difficult to defend against, causing many cultivators to tense up.

Even the white cloud in You Yunshou’s sleeve paused slightly.

Yun Wuji hesitated not, very decisively severing the polluted cloud qi by demon fire.

The cloud qi fell, within a few breaths, burned into muddy ashes by the dark azure demon fire.

The White Cloud Banner swayed in mid-air, shaking off the deep blue scale patterns on the surface, but the banner surface cracked a thin line.

Yun Wuji’s sleeves swayed, surging mana, washed away the burning signs, yet the sleeve ends ultimately retained traces of scorch marks.

Seeing this, Yun Wuji deeply understood that following his current rhythm, he likely couldn’t withstand it. He dared not be careless, directly crushing[A Thread of Returning Cloud Bottle]!

The clear white cloud qi in the bottle gushed forth as a spring, quickly replenishing the severed cloud domain within mere breaths.

The cloud qi rolled, rapidly forming the first cloud sea of true significance on the clear sky battlefield!

Not thick, yet extended.

Not wide, yet sufficient for Yun Wuji to borrow, hide, and unload force.

The Nine Fire Dragon Lord showed an angry expression.

He deliberately chose the Clear Sky Martial Arts Arena, yet Yun Wuji boldly paved a white cloud territory under his fiery fire and Jiaoyang.

Yun Wuji looked at [A Thread of Returning Cloud Bottle], also painfully.

"Great, great!" The Nine Fire Dragon Lord laughed in fury, the Nine Orifice Furnace Heart Pendant on his chest vibrated fiercely.

Seventh Transformation, Dragon Collection.

Nine Fires simultaneously moved!

Earth Fire as the furnace base, Wood Fire as kindling, Thunder Fire as the furnace roar, Heart Fire as the furnace breath, True Fire as the furnace light, Pill Fire as the furnace heart, Spiritual Fire as the furnace thread, Demon Fire as the furnace poison, Dragon Fire as the furnace master.

Nine types of flames suddenly converged in the clear sky, transforming into the phantom of a nine-colored fire furnace. The furnace flipped downward, on its walls, nine fire dragon reliefs lifted their heads and roamed, dragon eyes lit simultaneously.

Nine Fires Combined Furnace!

Although this wasn’t a quasi-divine power, it was also a grand technique formed by the Nine Fire Dragon Lord over forty years of hard practice with Nine Fires in One Furnace.

Once the fire furnace phantom was formed, the clear sky descended heavily as if collapsing. The cloud sea Yun Wuji had just laid was entirely drawn into the furnace. White clouds, thin mist, cloud skin, refracted shadows, along with Yun Wuji himself, all became objects within the furnace in an instant.
